description: Fetch a reviewed public page and return its readable content as Markdown, with headings and list structure preserved. Script, style and template content is removed, and nav and aside elements plus anything marked role="navigation" are excluded from the text. Returns the licence and creator, because this content is reusable only on those terms. Truncation at any bound is reported, never silent. Pay 6000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

url.description: HTTPS URL on a reviewed public origin. Permitted origins: https://docs.python.org, https://developer.mozilla.org, https://en.wikipedia.org, https://www.cisa.gov, https://www.sec.gov, https://home.treasury.gov, https://books.toscrape.com. robots.txt is honoured and redirects are refused.
